# Lupi agent guide

This publication is maintained by the Lupi product owner in the Lupi repository.
Version: student-surface-2026-09-04. Canonical source: https://github.com/alexwelcing/Lupi

Lupi serves the open, inspect, learn, measure, save, and export workflow for molecular data.
The human homepage contains an explicit student collection, not a feed of research outputs.
The default public search filters that collection. New examples require an intentional curation decision.

The edge MCP manifest is at /mcp-manifest.json; the browser viewer manifest is at /browser-mcp-manifest.json.
Consult the relevant manifest before calling a tool. Edge RenderRequestV1 is validation-only and returns awaiting_renderer.
Do not claim artifact bytes, execution, or parity from a validation result.
The browser bridge can execute supported profiles after a viewer is mounted.

Keep source data, coordinate-derived observations, inferred display bonds, and unsupported claims distinct.
Local checks do not prove CI, deployment, live APIs, or the public-site revision.
Lupi does not execute research campaigns or choose model policy. Those concerns belong to separate products.
